success.description: Pestilential vapours surround the target, afflicting him with a random disease with the Filth or Miasma traits. This disease lasts until the end of the encounter, at which point the target makes an Average (2{Df}) Resilience (To) check to shake it off. If he fails, the disease becomes permanent.
